claimed_purpose.text: Evaluates LLMs' ability to extract information from historical memory in long-context dialogues and correctly call tools.

mechanisms.text: Topological sort merges multiple conversation sequences into a globally consistent temporal sequence; heuristic drops the node with the highest out-degree to resolve cyclic conflicts.
Memory anchoring validation supports exact match and soft match including date conversion, token overlap, fuzzy match, and semantic similarity
Structured facts extracted from conversations; BERTopic used for semantic clustering to detect memory evolution and conflicts
Raw data drawn from three source datasets: BFCL, OASST1, and ToolACE, converted to a unified conversation format

ledger.claim: Benchmark evaluates memory-driven tool calling in long-context dialogue
ledger.quote: 该项目旨在评估大语言模型在长上下文对话中，从历史记忆中提取信息并正确调用工具的能力。
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Dataset is synthetically constructed via LLM-assisted pipeline from BFCL, OASST1, and ToolACE source data
ledger.quote: 支持的数据集：`bfcl` - Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard / `oasst1` - Open Assistant 数据集 / `toolace` - ToolACE 数据集
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Difficulty levels L1–L4 are assigned based on source count, explicit/inferred parameter ratio, and presence of temporal conflict
ledger.quote: L1 Direct-Copy 单一来源，字面匹配，全是 explicit / L2 Semantic-Understanding 单一来源，需要推理/转换，有 inferred / L3 Cross-turn-Aggregation 多个来源，信息分散但无冲突 / L4 Conflict-Resolution 多个来源且有 inferred，或有时序冲突
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Memory anchoring validation uses soft match methods: date conversion, token overlap, fuzzy match, semantic similarity
ledger.quote: **记忆锚定验证**：支持精确匹配和软匹配（日期转换、Token Overlap、模糊匹配、语义相似度）
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Full benchmark output includes session conversations and QA evaluation data; a small version (350 QA items) is also generated
ledger.quote: 自动生成小版本数据集（默认 350 条 QA） ... Mem2ACTbench_small/ # 小版本（用于快速测试）
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Topological sort used for global temporal ordering; heuristic discards highest out-degree node to break cycles
ledger.quote: 使用优化的拓扑排序处理序列依赖 / 启发式策略处理循环冲突（丢弃出度最高的节点）
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: BERTopic used for semantic clustering of extracted facts to detect memory evolution and conflicts
ledger.quote: 从对话中提取结构化事实，并使用 BERTopic 进行语义聚类，检测记忆演化和冲突。
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Benchmark purpose is active memory-to-action evaluation, contrasting with prior benchmarks that only test passive fact retrieval.
ledger.quote: Existing benchmarks, however, primarily test an agent's ability to passively retrieve isolated facts in response to explicit questions. They fail to evaluate the more crucial capability of actively applying memory to execute tasks.
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Benchmark is a pipeline for constructing memory-driven tool-calling evaluation datasets for LLMs.
ledger.quote: Mem2ACTBench 是一个用于构建记忆驱动工具调用（Memory-Driven Tool Calling）基准测试数据集的完整流水线。
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Input sources are BFCL, OASST1, and ToolACE datasets converted to a unified JSONL conversation format.
ledger.quote: bfcl - Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard / oasst1 - Open Assistant 数据集 / toolace - ToolACE 数据集
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Session format: session_id, original_conversation_ids, turns (role/content/source_id/tool_calls), turn_count (default 12), has_tool_calls, token_count.
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: QA format: qa_id, source_conversation_ids, evolution_chain, query, tool_call (name + arguments + grounding_info), target_tool_schema, complexity_metadata (level L1–L4).
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Dataset construction is synthetic/automated: LLM (Qwen/Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct by default) is used for conversation building and fact extraction; not human-annotated.
ledger.locator: README.md §通用参数 / §02_extract_facts_conflicts.py 参数说明
ledger.label: inferred

ledger.claim: Two output splits: full benchmark (Mem2ActBench/) and small version (Mem2ACTbench_small/, default 350 QA items) for quick testing.
ledger.quote: Mem2ACTbench_small/ # 小版本（用于快速测试）... 自动生成小版本数据集（默认 350 条 QA）
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Memory anchoring verification for scorer uses exact match, date conversion, token overlap, fuzzy match, and semantic similarity.
ledger.quote: 记忆锚定验证：支持精确匹配和软匹配（日期转换、Token Overlap、模糊匹配、语义相似度）
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Tool pool extracted from ToolACE dataset, deduplicated, stored as tool_api_pool.json.
ledger.quote: tool_api_pool.json - 去重后的工具 API 定义
ledger.label: measured
